text:
mchen: quick heads-up — PR #4218 is blocked by CI. staging-integ shard7 kept dying with a GPU timeout (exit 137) and there's a small snapshot diff. need quick eyes + approval for a targeted rerun.

ajones: looking now. can you paste the failing snippet?

mchen: sure — here's the relevant tail from the job:```
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] ERROR: inference_worker.cc:1423 | kernel launch failed: cudaErrorIllegalInstruction
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] WARNING: supervisor: process 8421 exited with code 137 (OOM?)
--- snapshot-diff: ui/components/query-panel.test.png ---
- expected: ...timestamp: 2026-03-18T15:11:59Z...
+ actual:   ...timestamp: 2026-03-18T15:12:00Z...
```

samir-r: hmm looks like a transient OOM/driver hiccup (exit 137) — unrelated to the JS change? the timestamp diff smells like a rendering nondeterminism rather than a semantic change.

mchen: I only touched the query param parsing in server side; no UI changes. agree it's likely nondet.

ci-bot: Buildkite: step "staging-integ (shard 7)" failed — exit code 137. job: https://buildkite.example/9382

linda: i can approve a targeted rerun if you limit it to shard7 and include the rerun logs for triage. if it passes we either accept the snapshot or update it if it's purely timestamp whitespace. :+1:

ajones: +1 from me. if it flakes again we should open a quick bisect and hold merge until we root cause.

mchen: starting targeted rerun now (scope: shard=7 only) — command:```
./tools/ci/run-targeted.sh --pr 4218 --shard 7 --reason "targeted rerun after gpu timeout"
```

ci-bot: Buildkite: triggered rerun job id 9385 (targeted: shard7) — started by mchen.

ci-bot: Buildkite: job 9385 finished — status: passed. all staging-integ shards green.

mchen: rerun passed. snapshot diff was just the timestamp line — i'll update the golden to normalize timestamp formatting in the test to avoid future flakes. aiming to push a tiny follow-up to normalize the renderer.

linda: approved for merge queue :thumbsup: go ahead and merge once you push the normalization change or if you prefer we can land this PR and follow up — your call.

mchen: i'll land PR #4218 now and open PR #4220 with the timestamp-normalize patch. thanks for the quick eyes everyone.

ajones: thanks, great coordination. :rocket:
